dedupe_keys.name: sots satellite earth observation system and maps abe of the bolivian space agency

description: The Bolivian Space Agency (ABE) runs, through its satellite image processing and analysis laboratory (LPAIS), two public viewers of satellite data for Bolivia. SOTS, the satellite Earth observation system, lets users view Sentinel, Landsat and high-resolution satellite images and indicators for the whole of Bolivia across different years, with sites of interest for forest fire response and themes for lithium, crops, land cover, PM2.5 and forest fires; ABE says it built SOTS because satellite observation is a key tool for environmental monitoring, meteorology, disaster response, agriculture and water. MAPS ABE shows a map of slow ground movements, water bodies detected with radar images, and information from the Tupac Katari (TKSAT-1) satellite. The laboratory also carries out remote sensing consultancy with Google Earth Engine and machine learning, and supplies high-resolution multispectral, hyperspectral and radar images through agreements with other space agencies and companies, on request. The viewers are free online; imagery and consultancy are on request, and no data licence is stated on the pages read. Caveats: the pages are in Spanish, and SOTS loads its layers by script. Coverage is Bolivia. It supports hazard exposure and emergency response analysis of wildfires, floods and ground movement around roads, mines and settlements; related records are MapBiomas Bolivia and the CONAE geoportal.
